[3.15] Always close OutputStream in RESTEasy Classic

body:
Thank you for the quick fix. 
Would it be possible to include this fix also in the current LTS release 3.15.X?

@Urmel2005 sorry, we weren't very vocal about this issue but I wanted to take the time to properly thank you, both for the report and for the reproducer, that helped us going to the bottom of it very quickly.

This led to us opening a CVE (`CVE-2025-1634`) that we wanted to fix ASAP and it was part of the recent security fixes we published (https://quarkus.io/blog/cve-fixes-feb-2025/).

If you encounter a similar issue in the future, we encourage you to use our security point of contact instead at `security at quarkus dot io` as this type of issue warrants going through our security process. And if you have a doubt, you can ask first on our security email and we will redirect you here if we don't think it's a security issue.

Thanks again!
